title: Beyond ‘Dreamers’: K-pop’s soundtrack for 2026 FIFA World Cup
contentSnippet: Held once every four years, the tournament attracts billions of viewers worldwide and has long inspired musicians to release official FIFA anthems, national team songs, and unofficial tributes.

title: Stalled road widening leaves over 500 structures in ruins in Hetauda
contentSnippet: Court delays have frozen a key highway widening, turning the town’s main commercial stretch into a damaged, unsafe and dust-filled zone with blackout risks and disrupted businesses.
